race.comment: Very open. OCEANA DREAM (1) and GENEVA (6) clashed first up at Cranbourne over 1600m. OCEANA DREAM got a long way back as the $3.40 favourite and ran on well for fourth while GENEVA, off an SA Derby failure, sat on speed and stuck on well for second. Not much between them but we'll lean the way of OCEANA DREAM, both horses should handle a wet track no worries. KILLENAULE (12) was rewarded for consistency last start with a soft win at Cranbourne over 2025m. He might be able to go on with it now. THE MUFFIN MAN (17) is knocking on the door with a strong finish at Bendigo last time. 1800m looks ideal off that although a wet track is some query.
